{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & 
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Confirm the number of rows after filtering
print(f'Number of rows after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum().round(2)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.max()

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel, best_channel, best_revenue"}
